name: Hedy Lamarr
summary: Hedy Lamarr was an actor and inventor whose work on frequency hopping anticipated later communications technologies.

facts.text: Lamarr co-invented a frequency-hopping communication system with composer George Antheil during World War II.
facts.context: Her story challenges narrow ideas about expertise by showing technical imagination in someone best known publicly for film.
